rappel_detail.anchor: natural: slung horn or chockstone; no fixed anchors in this sub-range
rappel_detail.station: Near the top of the south arete, above its steepest section.
rappel_detail.notes: Optional. Most parties downclimb the way they came; a single short rappel on a 30 m rope protects the steepest section if the rock is wet or icy.

set.rappels: Usually none: downclimb the route. 1 optional short rappel on a 30 m rope off a natural anchor near the top of the arete if wet or icy
set.descent: Reverse the ascent: downclimb the south face, arete and west-face traverse to the notch below the summit horn, then descend snow and talus to the Crooked Thumb Glacier camp.
